Who We Are : 

 Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders. 

 How You Will Make an Impact: 

 The AI Developer is a technical, entry-level role within the Atlas Technology team that builds and maintains AI solutions across the business. 

 Responsibilities 

 
 AI-powered features and applications such as conversational interfaces, workflow automations, MCP servers, and computer vision. 

 Connect AI solutions with Atlas internal systems, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, third-party APIs, and operational data sources. 

 Implement testing strategies for AI behavior including prompt evaluation, regression testing, output validation, and model performance. 

 Apply authentication patterns, data protection controls, and audit logging. 

 Ensure responsible and compliant AI usage by reinforcing approved tools, data handling, and governance guardrails; coordinate privacy/security reviews and escalate risks and exceptions as needed. 

 Monitor deployed solutions for performance, reliability, and cost. Respond to incidents, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvement through analytics and user feedback. 

 
 Minimum qualifications 

 
 Bachelor’s degree (in disciplines relevant to business process improvement or technology adoption) or equivalent practical experience/training. 

 Programming: Foundational proficiency in one general purpose programming language (e.g. Python or C#) and one front end framework (e.g. React/JavaScript) 

 Comfort with REST APIs, JSON, DBs and basic data structures 

 Foundations: Understanding of AI/ML/LLM concepts (prompting, embeddings, retrieval) through coursework, personal projects, or internship 

 AI/ML/LLM concepts or project experience 

 Eligible to work in the U.S. without future sponsorship. 

 Demonstrated experience through relevant personal projects with publicly shareable artifacts (e.g., GitHub repositories, demos, technical write-ups, or case studies). 

 
 Preferred qualifications 

 
 Experience building LLM-powered applications and automations 

 Exposure to cloud platforms and DevOps practices (Azure Functions, CI/CD pipelines, Git/GitHub, containers). 

 Familiarity with Microsoft tools such as Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Graph APIs and collaboration platforms (e.g., Teams and SharePoint) 

 Completion of relevant AI-focused certifications and/or accredited boot camps. 

 
 What You Will Love About Us 

 
 Best People and Team. Great Place to Work , Hire Vets, Top Place to Work For – Austin American Statesman 

 Your Well-Being is a Priority. 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision 

 Invest in Your Future. 401K with company match, immediate vesting 

 Relax and Recharge. Paid time off (non-rotational roles), 15+ company paid holidays 

 
  

 Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:
 Atlas Energy Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

 This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 
 Atlas Energy Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and those with pregnancy-related conditions in accordance with applicable law. 

 Job Disclaimer 
 This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified at any time based on business needs.
